question: What power does the enjoyer of wine possess over even the immortal gods?
premises: There is an enjoyer of wine.
Wine has the power to delude.
Even immortals are susceptible to such delusion.
inference: The proper enjoyer of wine wields a power capable of affecting even the gods.
uncertainties: Whether this praises mastery or warns of danger depends on the wider ritual context.
plain_english: Oh, the enjoyer of wine could delude even the immortals.
